name: Existing customer - Next Up Anytime early upgrade
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: laid-back, short sentences.
scripted_messages: Hi. I'm an existing customer and curious about Next Up Anytime. The site says early upgrades cost an extra $10 a month and allow up to 3 upgrades in 12 months. How does it work if I want to upgrade to a new iPhone, and what happens to my current phone?
Ok. Is the $10 added to my monthly bill?
And can I cancel it later?
One detail, when does the first upgrade become available after signing up?
Got it, makes sense. Appreciate your help and how friendly you were.
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
